mechanism: simp [<definitions named in the goal, restricted to the allowlist>]
homogeneity_note: All wins share one mechanism — definitional unfold via `simp [def]` where the def is named in the goal and is not @[simp]. Subfamilies differ only in WHICH defs (order predicates vs Finset.disjUnion), not in mechanism, so a single allowlist-gated action covers them; NOT CANDIDATE_TOO_HETEROGENEOUS.
